status: Proposed construction drawing; not approved/shared CAD, supplier-confirmed build, FEA, test or recognized finished component

parts.wire_P_A: ELEKTRISOLA Polysol180 P180 Cu0.180mm Grade2; procurement must identify recognized MW82-C/OBMW2 manufacturing site
parts.wire_S: Furukawa TEX-E Cu0.30mm / E206440 recognized grade; continuous intact three-layer insulation outside controlled terminal zones
parts.tape: 3M1350F-1; exact marked/recognized grade, no generic polyester substitute

pitch_definition: Conservative turn-cell width: n*pitch=13.8mm. Actual center-to-center occupied span=(n-1)*pitch+wireOD is smaller. Spread S and A evenly; do not close-pack into narrower subbands.
P_connection: One continuous120-turn wire,60 inner plus60 outer, same winding sense in electrical series; park the continuous bridge in the primary-side end pocket without a splice or extra pin. Start1 and finish5. No use of NC pins as a hidden junction.
S_connection: One continuous30-turn TIW wire,15+15 in electrical series with a controlled end crossover; dot6/finish10 and continuous insulation into terminal zones.

seams.required: All6wrap seams staggered; no coincident ridge, no6layer overlap.0.077mm is imposed incoming upper thickness, not a new vendor guarantee.

leadout_contract.native_coordinates: Bobbin STEP X,Y,Z. PCB component-side coordinates x=X,y=-Z; pins project +Y; source mark/dot map preserved.
leadout_contract.bridge_protection: Candidate optional FIS-B3-listed Essex Furukawa PIT-S tubing; incoming required ID>=0.25mm,OD<=0.60mm. Dimensions are a new procurement requirement, not sourced product capability or a complete barrier rating.
leadout_contract.routing: P/A starts, finishes and parked bridge exit only to row1-5 at negativeZ; S starts/finish and crossover exit only to row6-10 at positiveZ. NC pins stay unwound. No stripped secondary wire may traverse core/yoke/primary pockets.
leadout_contract.not_verified: End-pocket axial arithmetic does not prove bend radius, local radial/core/yoke clearance, barrier continuity or real winding-machine capability. A dimensioned actual3D exit/yoke section remains mandatory.

material_process_requirements: Builder must adopt/confirm actual FIS-B3 recognized material functions/sites/grades; no recognition is claimed for this finished transformer.
P/A two complete1350F-1 wraps retained; S TIW supplies its stated component function, not an assumed end-product standard pass.
No base wrap assumes actual PM-9630 all-path wall>=0.3mm and source-function acceptance; this remains unverified.
Off-bobbin TIW end preparation and qualified pin joining remain separate. No420C wire test copied onto bobbin.
Do not add varnish, adhesive or tube substitutions outside confirmed EIS. PIT-S listing alone does not confirm selected size or bend capability.

A-to-outerP has three intervening complete1350F-1 wraps (around A, between S layers, before outerP); do not count spaced TIW roundwires themselves as a continuous sheet barrier. Exit paths still require separate all-path review.

magnetic_acceptance.method: Three-winding impedance model from independently measured pair conditions and operation checks, with fixture compensation/frequency/signal/amplitude recorded;20uH not established by this drawing or slab model.

insulation_access: Core/yokes treated as hazardous primary-domain objects; bare secondary terminal pockets require actual air/surface/solid separation assessment. No norm-derived clearance, creepage or test voltage is adopted here.
effect_on_old_evidence: Ideal turns graph/values retained; winding distribution, length/DCR, leakage/capacitance and field coupling change. Old winding-specific startup/clamp/parasitic/thermal/process calculations cannot be claimed validated for this construction without affected re-analysis.
cut_length_status: Design/procurement acceptance proposal with explicit reserve above regular helical calculation; not confirmed builder capability. TEX-E source R20 is reference table, so exact purchased-wire resistance requirement must be agreed.
